task: Extract every algorithm, heuristic, scoring function, constraint solver, state machine, and data pipeline from BukSU CMS-V2 with technical specs, process explanations, justifications, paper-ready narratives (Chapters 1-5), and chapter mappings, exported as a comprehensive Microsoft Word (.docx) document.

lessons_learned.lesson: Microsoft Word locks open files with exclusive OS write locks on Windows. Always implement a graceful fallback in document generator scripts to write to an alternative timestamped or descriptive path when PermissionError [Errno 13] is encountered.
lessons_learned.prevention: Generator scripts must trap PermissionError on doc.save and save to an alternative filename so automated tasks never crash or fail due to active user inspection.
lessons_learned.runbook: python scripts/generate_algorithm_audit_docx.py compiles all 22 algorithms from scripts/audit_data into docs/BukSU_CMS_V2_Comprehensive_Algorithm_Audit_Report.docx.
checklist: Extracted 22 algorithms across 6 domains with sections A to F
Provided paper-ready narrative paragraphs for Chapters 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5
Included Complexity Matrix, Justification Matrix, Process Inventory
Formatted institutional BukSU Word document with 1201 paragraphs and 95 tables
All governance tests and endpoint parity verified
lessons_learned.evidence: Generated 119,721-byte Word document with 22 algorithms verified via docx parsing; all 60 agentic checks passed.
